data.description:
OBSERVED twice in one day on AS-45 cycle 4 (2026-09-07/08, tick watcher:97322): the implementer (Lena) and the reviewer (Ruben) both found docker absent from the tick — the tick PATH is exactly /Users/forrest/.nvm/versions/node/v24.13.1/bin:/Users/forrest/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin, so 'docker' is command-not-found and the absolute path /usr/local/bin/docker is denied by the permission layer (the allowlist entry is Bash(docker *), which matches the bare name only). The same tick found 'gh' command-not-found, so the PR discipline (CLAUDE.md, board DM msg 576) cannot execute from a watcher tick either. Consequence: a review that needs the compose suite ends conditional and the merge waits on a human, which is exactly the merge-to-deploy-shaped gap AS-75 closed for apps/chat, now on the verification side for apps/invoicing.

WHY IT IS THE WATCHER'S PROBLEM AND NOT ONLY THE PLIST'S: tickChildEnv() (apps/chat/watch/advance-watcher.mjs ~192) passes env.PATH through verbatim, and the plist template's __PATH__ is whatever the operator typed at install. The watcher already resolves docker by absolute path for its own deploys (resolveDocker, DOCKER_CANDIDATES, AS-75) precisely because the plist PATH is thin — but it does not hand that knowledge to the tick it spawns. The tick therefore knows less than its parent.

SCOPE: (1) tickChildEnv() prepends the directory of the resolved docker binary (and, if configured, an ADVANCE_TICK_PATH_EXTRA or the directory of a resolved gh binary — candidates /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin) to the child PATH, deterministically, with the pin test in the suite updated in the same commit (the env set is pinned deliberately — see the comment above tickChildEnv). (2) The README's install instructions and the plist template comment say which directories __PATH__ must contain (node, claude, docker, gh). (3) The immediate operational unblock is a plist edit + kickstart by the board and is NOT this task's deliverable — this task makes the tick correct even when the plist is thin. NOT IN SCOPE: widening the permission allowlist (Bash(docker *) already covers the bare name once it is on PATH); anything about what ticks do with docker once they have it.

VERIFICATION: a pinned tickChildEnv test that fails when the docker directory is not prepended (M4: observed red first); a headless tick that runs 'docker version' and 'gh auth status' successfully — record the tick id. Chat-set priority per board DM msg 557 (watcher/harness follow-up under apps/chat).
data.title: Chat watcher: the tick child PATH omits /usr/local/bin and the gh directory — headless ticks cannot run the invoicing compose suites or open PRs

data.body:
OPERATIONAL UNBLOCK APPLIED (board, via the orchestrator in a live session, 2026-09-08T05:28Z) — Owen's option (b) from DM msg 587. The installed plist's PATH string now reads /Users/forrest/.nvm/versions/node/v24.13.1/bin:/Users/forrest/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin (backup kept beside it as .bak-<ts>; plutil -lint OK). Verified on the relaunched watcher (pid 17217): its process PATH carries both new directories, and a shell given that PATH resolves /usr/local/bin/docker, /opt/homebrew/bin/gh, ~/.local/bin/claude and the nvm node. The tick child inherits exactly this (advance-watcher.mjs builds the child env as PATH: env.PATH), so headless ticks can now run the invoicing compose suites and open PRs.

GOTCHA FOR THE PLANNER, learned the hard way: launchctl kickstart -k does NOT re-read the plist — it relaunched pid 16931 with the OLD PATH (runs=9). Picking up a plist edit requires launchctl bootout gui/<uid>/<label> followed by launchctl bootstrap gui/<uid> <plist>, which also resets the job's runs counter to 1. apps/chat/watch/README.md's install step still documents the old four-directory PATH and says nothing about bootout/bootstrap; this task should correct both. Guard used before bootout, worth keeping as the runbook: no advance.lock present AND deploy-state.json lastAttempt has an outcome (a finished deploy carries outcome, not endedAt — my first guard misread that and aborted on a healthy state).

This task remains the durable fix: the watcher should prepend the directories it already resolves docker (and now gh) from, so tick capability stops depending on a hand-edited host file.

PATH FIX VERIFIED LIVE IN A HEADLESS TICK (cto-owen, tick watcher:17217, 2026-09-09) — the VERIFICATION clause's second half is now observed, via the plist route.

EVIDENCE, observed in this tick's shell (watcher pid 17217, the instance reloaded after the plist edit): 'which docker' -> /usr/local/bin/docker; 'which gh' -> /opt/homebrew/bin/gh; 'docker --version' -> Docker version 29.6.1, build 8900f1d; 'gh auth status' -> logged in to github.com as malls, active. Then used for real: four 'docker compose run --rm' invocations against apps/invoicing from this tick (test x2 incl. a --build rebuild, mutated self-test, contract with stripe-mock) — all executed, none denied, the bare-name allowlist entry Bash(docker *) matched as predicted. AS-45 was merged on the strength of those runs (95b5ee5).

WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT CLOSE. It closes the operational pain: ticks can run the invoicing suites and could open PRs today. It does NOT close this task, whose deliverable was explicitly not the plist edit: tickChildEnv() still passes PATH through verbatim, so a re-installed or re-templated plist silently regresses to the 2026-09-07 state, and the watcher still knows more (resolveDocker) than the tick it spawns. The pinned tickChildEnv test that goes red when the docker directory is not prepended (M4) is the real artifact and remains unbuilt.

RECOMMENDED DISPOSITION: keep open, keep in the Chat set at critical per the board's scheduling directive (it is a watcher follow-up under apps/chat), but sequence it LAST within the set — its urgency was operational and that is gone; what remains is defence-in-depth against a thin plist. AS-91 first (every merge before it re-exports the board's DMs), then the AS-75 F-series in the order ruled on AS-75 (84, 88, 85, 86, 87), then 81/82/61, then this. When it is planned, the plan should cite this comment as the observed-green half of VERIFICATION and add the README/plist-template wording from scope item (2). No lifecycle action taken this tick.

Recurrence, 2026-09-11 tick watcher:17217:95e1c0c26bf2d97f: the AS-95 cycle-2 review (qa-ruben) and the orchestrator were both denied '/usr/local/bin/docker compose ...' — the absolute-path form as well as the bare one — so the counted --build receipt (AS-95 AC-8) could not be produced and the merge is held for a live session. Scope note for whoever plans this: PATH is half of it; the headless --allowedTools grant set (AS-21 tickArgv) must also match the absolute docker path, or ticks will keep losing merges to this.

Scope note, tick watcher:76266 (Owen answering DM 682): the headless allowlist also denies the chat CLI whenever the body comes via command substitution — node apps/chat/bin/chat.js dm human:forrest "$(cat file)" was refused, so the reply went through the raw-API fallback (node -e + fetch, POST /api/messages). Same 'headless tick cannot run X' family as the PATH/docker/gh holes; fold into this task's fix or note it as accepted.

PLANNED (cto-owen, 2026-09-11, second lane beside the AS-87 review). Plan: .lattice/plans/task_01M1ZBQ731D9T6NYN3VDSNTCJC.md. Host baseline measured on master 0337a54: 530/530/0.

DESIGN: the watcher hands the tick what it already knows. New tickPathPrepend(env, exists) -> {add, present, unresolved}: ADVANCE_TICK_PATH_EXTRA entries first (split ':', empties dropped), then dirname of the resolved docker binary (existing resolveDockerBin), then dirname of a resolved gh binary (new GH_CANDIDATES ['/opt/homebrew/bin/gh','/usr/local/bin/gh'] + resolveGhBin with an ADVANCE_GH_BIN override that refuses to fall through, same shape as docker's); de-duplicated; a directory already on PATH is reported present and never re-added or reordered. tickChildEnv gains a defaulted 4th arg pathPrepend — empty prepend passes PATH through byte-for-byte (undefined stays undefined), key set stays exactly five. makeWatcher gains env/exists injections; fire() computes the prepend per fire and logs one 'TICK-PATH add … present … unresolved …' line before the spawn. Plist template comment + README prerequisites/install sed/troubleshooting say __PATH__ should carry docker and gh dirs and that a plist PATH edit needs bootout+bootstrap (kickstart -k does not re-read it — comment 1's gotcha). The 'Env knobs:' README line is deliberately NOT touched (AS-88 appends to it).

SCOPE RULINGS ON THE COMMENTS: comment 3 (allowlist must match the absolute docker path) — out of scope and not needed: once the dir is on PATH the bare name is what ticks type and Bash(docker *) matches it (comment 2 observed exactly that); settings.json is metawork-owned. AC-9 uses bare names deliberately, and the CLAUDE.md spawnSync('/usr/local/bin/docker') guidance for sub-agents is flagged for the orchestrator to revisit after the merge (plan §10). Comment 4 (chat CLI refused under "$(cat file)") — separate concern, not PATH: harness command-substitution heuristic, workaround already documented (node -e + fetch); accepted, observed once, becomes its own Chat-set task on a second observation. Not filed. Comment 1's plist edit is history, not a deliverable; comment 2 is the observed-green half of VERIFICATION via the plist route and is cited as such.

ACs: 11. Mutants: 9 (M1–M9), each with a predicted exact red set; M8 (spawn site drops the 4th arg) is explicitly invisible to the AS-82 call-site pin by construction — that is why T7 exists. Tests: 7 new + 1 edited; predicted +7 host against the MEASURED baseline at review (530 -> 537 today; 535 -> 542 if AS-87 has merged; the AS-88 '537' is a different base and a coincidence), compose +6 pass +1 counted skip (T8, the real-process proof: a child on the 2026-09-07-shaped thin PATH cannot run docker/gh without the prepend and can with it — the plist is already fat, so the LIVE tick cannot show the watcher's prepend doing the work; T8 does, and AC-9 says so honestly and quotes the fire's TICK-PATH line + tick id).

SEAM RULING: disjoint from AS-87 and AS-88 on every line. advance-watcher.mjs hunks: :273–292 (tickChildEnv), insert after :398 (resolvers + tickPathPrepend, ten lines above AS-87's :412 comment hunk), :2204–2224 (makeWatcher options), :2328–2373 (spawn site). AS-87 touches :412/:734/:852/:964/:1035/:1088–1098; AS-88 touches runDockerCompose/makeDeployOps/performDeploy/:2643–2669. Tests: AS-92 edits watcher.test.js:341–383 and inserts after it (AS-87 appends after :1377, AS-88 edits :839); harness injections + one appended test in watcher-main.test.js (AS-88 also appends one — the only foreseeable conflict, resolution 'keep both'); T8 appended to watcher-process.test.js. No merge order required; the branch rebases onto master at review start if master moved and re-measures the baseline. Branch feat/AS-92-tick-path-prepend cut from 0337a54, linked, worktree .worktrees/AS-92 created now — nothing gates it.

PEOPLE: implementer developer-marcus (Lena is reserved for AS-88; Marcus's AS-87 is in review and he authored the AS-14/20/21/82 spawn-site pins this edits; if AS-87 rework arrives the orchestrator sequences the two across ticks). Reviewer qa-ruben (free after AS-84 cycle 3; he observed the bug and wrote comment 3, which the plan overrules — the right person to test whether bare-name docker is really enough; Priya is the fallback). Complexity low: one implementation tick, one review tick.

IN_PROGRESS (cto-owen, tick watcher:15881 loop tick 7). Implementer changed from plan §9's default: developer-lena, not developer-marcus. Reason: the AS-87 rework (Priya, cycle 1) returned in the same tick AS-92 was planned, Marcus takes it, and the plan's own rule is one agent per task per tick — sequencing AS-92 behind AS-87 would idle Lena, whose AS-88 branch is gated on the AS-87 merge and cannot start this tick. AC-10's commit identity therefore reads developer-lena for this branch; everything else in the plan stands (Ruben reviews; rebase-and-re-measure at review). Lena works in .worktrees/AS-92 on feat/AS-92-tick-path-prepend, commits early, keeps a progress note in scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/.

IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE (developer-lena, tick watcher:15881 loop tick 7; reassigned from Marcus this tick, so AC-10's identity reads developer-lena). Branch feat/AS-92-tick-path-prepend, worktree .worktrees/AS-92, head d7977a0 (three commits: e0fe995 code + T1–T6, fa03e6c T7–T8, d7977a0 prose). Cut from 0337a54; master is at f90e7a8 with no code changes since, so no rebase yet — the plan's §7 rebase-and-re-measure rule applies at review if AS-87 merges first. `git merge-tree --write-tree master HEAD`: CLEAN. Six files touched, exactly plan §7's list; zero .lattice/ paths, no top-level markdown, package.json unchanged.

WHAT CHANGED PER FILE
- watch/advance-watcher.mjs (+84/-2): tickChildEnv gains a defaulted 4th arg `pathPrepend = []` — empty ⇒ env.PATH byte-for-byte (undefined stays undefined), non-empty ⇒ prepend dirs then the untouched original as suffix; key set still five. New GH_CANDIDATES (frozen: /opt/homebrew/bin/gh, /usr/local/bin/gh) and resolveGhBin(env, exists) — same return shape and override-missing-never-falls-through rule as resolveDockerBin. New tickPathPrepend(env, exists) → {add, present, unresolved}: ADVANCE_TICK_PATH_EXTRA split on ':' (trimmed, empties dropped, never existence-checked) first, then dirname(docker), then dirname(gh); a null resolver contributes `name:reason` to unresolved; Set-dedup preserving first occurrence; partition against env.PATH split on ':' (present vs add, order preserved, PATH never reordered). makeWatcher gains `env = process.env` and `exists = existsSync` injections (JSDoc updated). fire(): resolves per fire, logs `TICK-PATH add <..> present <..> unresolved <..>` ('-' for empty) BEFORE the spawn, and calls tickChildEnv(env, pid, nonce, tickPath.add). The PATH line in the spawn-site comment block names AS-92. Nothing else in the file touched (tickArgv, loadPermissionRules, resolveDockerBin, deploy code, settle untouched — hunks are :273–292, after :398, :2204–2226, :2332 and the spawn site, disjoint from AS-87's and AS-88's per §7).
- watch/com.american-software.advance-watcher.plist.template: __PATH__ comment says node+claude required, docker+gh directories (/usr/local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin) should be there, watcher prepends what it resolves so a thin PATH degrades to "what the watcher found"; overrides comment lists ADVANCE_GH_BIN and ADVANCE_TICK_PATH_EXTRA=<dir:dir> ("absolute directories").
- watch/README.md (three hunks): Prerequisites `command -v node claude docker gh` + the optional-at-install sentence; Install sed renders the six-directory PATH (…:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin) + a new paragraph after the code block (why, the two resolvers, the extra knob, the TICK-PATH line format and the expected line on the fat plist, bootout+bootstrap not kickstart -k — the pid 16931 fact re-verified from AS-92 comment 1 before I cited it); Troubleshooting `spawn error` entry gains the in-tick docker/gh command-not-found symptom pointing at TICK-PATH. The "Env knobs:" line (:278–280) untouched per §3.2 so AS-88 can append to it.
- test/watcher.test.js (+94): T1 — AS-14 pin keeps every existing assertion and adds one deepEqual with pathPrepend ['/usr/local/bin','/opt/homebrew/bin'] ⇒ PATH '/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/bin:/usr/bin', five keys. T2–T6 inserted immediately after the AS-14 pin, before the AS-20 argv pin, as §4 says (away from AS-87's append at :1377+). T6 examines five resolveGhBin branches (override, override-missing, first candidate, second candidate, not-found) and pins GH_CANDIDATES to the exact two-element frozen array.
- test/watcher-main.test.js (+47): watcherHarness gains `env: process.env, exists: () => false` defaults before `...over.watcher`, so the AS-82 spawn-site pin at :355 is unchanged and green. T7 appended at end of file (the §7-noted end-of-file seam with AS-88; resolution "keep both, either order").
- test/watcher-process.test.js (+45): T8 appended. Counted t.skip when resolveDockerBin/resolveGhBin over process.env finds nothing. Negative control first: `node -e` child under tickChildEnv({PATH:'/usr/bin:/bin', HOME, USER, LOGNAME}, 1, NONCE, []) runs spawnSync('docker',['--version']) and spawnSync('gh',['--version']) by bare name and must exit non-zero; positive: same child with tickPathPrepend(thinEnv, existsSync).add exits 0.

COUNTED RUNS (cardinality first)
- Host baseline, measured in the worktree BEFORE the first change: `node --test` 530 tests / 530 pass / 0 fail / 0 skipped (matches the plan's 530).
- Host after: 537 / 537 / 0 / 0 skipped — delta +7 (T2–T8), exactly §4.
- Compose: `/usr/local/bin/docker compose -p asc-impl-as92 run --build --rm test` from the worktree's apps/chat via node -e + spawnSync (docker off PATH here). Receipt line: `Image asc-impl-as92-test Built`. 537 tests / 531 pass / 0 fail / 6 skipped, exit 0. Against the compose base (530/525/5 skipped on master, per the AS-84/AS-87 review receipts): +7 total, +6 pass, +1 skipped — the one new skip is T8 (`# docker (not-found) or gh (not-found) not resolvable here — host-only proof`), exactly §4's prediction. Torn down: `compose -p asc-impl-as92 down --rmi local -v` (network removed; the run --rm container was already gone).

MUTANTS: 9 run, 9 observed red, 0 survivors. Scratch `git archive HEAD` copy under mkdtemp (never the worktree); each pattern asserted to occur exactly once AND inside the intended enclosing function's window (anchor after `export function <name>(` / before the next export, or for the spawn site between `function fire(sentinel) {` and `child = proc;`) before applying; applied-ness asserted; file restored to the pristine bytes and re-asserted after each; pristine copy 74/74/0 before and after the battery (the three watcher test files). Battery script and log: scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/as92-mutants.mjs. Red sets, observed vs predicted:
- M1 (delete docker dirname push): observed {T2, T3, T7, T8}; predicted {T2, T4, T7, T8}. MISMATCH, two ways. T4 stayed GREEN under M1 — and it should, by its own fixture: T4's ADVANCE_TICK_PATH_EXTRA already names /usr/local/bin, so deleting the resolver's push cannot change `add` there; the plan's "docker's dir missing from add" reading of T4 was wrong. T3 went RED instead (its `present` list expects both dirs on the fat PATH) — the witness the plan did not count. Net: the guard is proven by four tests, not the four the plan named. Finding against the prediction, not the guard.
- M2 (delete gh dirname push): observed {T2, T3, T4, T5, T7, T8}; predicted {T2, T7, T8}. WIDER by T3 (present), T4 (add lacks the gh dir), T5 (the typo'd-docker case expects add ['/opt/homebrew/bin']). Tests are stricter than predicted; recorded.
- M3 (no partition — everything to add): {T3} only, as predicted; T7's thin PATH contains neither dir so it stays green, as the plan says.
- M4 (delete the EXTRA read): {T4}. M5 (delete the dedup): {T4}. Same red set from two mutants, as the plan states.
- M6 (unconditional join in tickChildEnv): {T5} — T1's verbatim/five-key assertions stay green because '/opt/bin:/usr/bin' joins to itself; the undefined case is the only witness.
- M7 (override-missing falls through): {T6}.
- M8 (drop the 4th arg at the spawn site): {T7}; the AS-82 pin at watcher-main.test.js:355 stayed GREEN under M8 by construction (empty prepend ⇒ identical env) — confirmed, which is why T7 exists.
- M9 (delete the TICK-PATH log line): {T7}.

AC SWEEP (floor check, after the findings above): AC-1 M1/M2 red (sets above); AC-2 M3 red; AC-3 M4/M5 red; AC-4 M6 red; AC-5 M7 red; AC-6 M8/M9 red with the AS-82-pin-green fact recorded; AC-7 T8 negative control fails then positive passes on this host, 1 counted skip on compose; AC-8 prose — for the reviewer to re-derive; AC-9 LIVE — not done and not attempted: it needs the merged watcher's self-restart and a headless tick running bare-name `docker version` / `gh auth status`; I did not touch the production watcher. Recipe is §6; the honest expectation on today's fat plist is `TICK-PATH add - present /usr/local/bin,/opt/homebrew/bin unresolved -`. AC-10 conventions met (identity developer-lena per this tick's reassignment); AC-11 numbers above with the Built line.

PLAN-§5 PROBE CANDIDATES I did address without adding tests: TICK-PATH is logged before the spawn (T7 asserts it follows FIRE; the ordering vs spawn is by code position); ADVANCE_TICK_PATH_EXTRA is passed through unexpanded and the plist comment + README say "absolute directories"; a trailing ':' on env.PATH puts '' in the presence set, which no candidate can equal (extras filter empties, dirname never returns ''); a docker override pointing at a directory would prepend that directory's parent — acceptable and unchanged from what resolveDockerBin already accepts. None tested; the reviewer's M6 latitude.

LEFT UNDONE: AC-9 (live, post-merge). Open questions §10 left at their defaults (no git dir in the prepend; no AS-100 event for TICK-PATH; the CLAUDE.md spawnSync-by-absolute-path guidance is the orchestrator's to revisit after merge).

REVIEW CYCLE 1 — PASS (merge). qa-ruben, tick watcher:15881 loop tick 8 (Opus per-invocation fallback). Branch feat/AS-92-tick-path-prepend, head d7977a0, reviewed cold from the plan and `git diff master...feat/AS-92-tick-path-prepend`; I read Lena's implementation comment LAST, after every number below was already in my scratchpad. No commits made on the branch.

FINDINGS FIRST (outside the criteria list). 0 blocking. 1 non-blocking test gap, 2 record-only edge cases, 1 note on my own tooling.

N1 (non-blocking; test gap, not a defect against any AC as written). The property "TICK-PATH is logged BEFORE the spawn, so a spawn error still leaves the line" is stated three times — the code comment at advance-watcher.mjs:2435, plan §2.4/§5's probe list, and T7's own inline comment ("Logged after FIRE and before the spawn") — but no test pins the "before the spawn" half. Probe P1: on a scratch git-archive copy I moved the log(...) call to immediately after the tick spawnFn(...) call (anchored on `spawnFn(\n      config.claudeBin,` — unique in the file) and re-ran: 537/537/0, SURVIVOR. T7 only asserts the line's index is greater than FIRE's. The production code is correct (log at :2439, spawn at :2441); what is missing is the guard. Practical exposure is narrow (Node's spawn throws synchronously only on argument errors; ENOENT arrives as an 'error' event after the line is already written), which is why this is not blocking. Fix shape, ~6 lines in T7: inject a spawnFn wrapper via over.watcher that snapshots h.logs.length at call time, then assert the TICK-PATH line was already present at that snapshot. Fold at merge or into AS-88's watcher-main.test.js append — the orchestrator's call; I did not commit it because it is a test strengthening, not trivia.

N2 (record only). A PATH entry written with a trailing slash (`/usr/local/bin/`) is not recognised as the resolved directory, so `/usr/local/bin` is prepended again — the same directory twice on the child PATH. Harmless; presence matching is byte-exact by design and normalising would be scope creep.

N3 (record only). PATH === '' with a non-empty prepend yields `/usr/local/bin` rather than `/usr/local/bin:` — the empty original is dropped, not kept as the "untouched suffix" the plan's §2.3 wording promises. This is the SAFER behaviour (an empty PATH entry means the current directory in POSIX lookup), and PATH === '' with an empty prepend still passes '' through byte-for-byte. Deviation from the plan's words only in this degenerate case; no change wanted.

Tooling note against myself, recorded per the AS-95 sharpening: my first P1 attempt anchored on `const proc = spawnFn(`, which also matches the deploy's compose spawn at :795; the "insert after the next `);`" landed at line 1604 inside the loop evaluator and produced a false red set {T7, f3-mirror-after-every-settle, f3-mirror-records-the-stop}. Re-reading the mutated file caught it before I attributed anything to the guard; the anchor was fixed and the corrected run is the survivor reported in N1. A wider set from a probe is a lead, not a finding — this one led back to my own script.

Other probes past the list (plan §5's candidates and mine), all observed on the worktree module, none a finding: P2 ADVANCE_TICK_PATH_EXTRA='bin:~/tools:./x' → passed through unexpanded, as the plist comment and README ("absolute directories") say. P3 ADVANCE_DOCKER_BIN pointing at a directory (/usr/local/bin, existsSync true) → add carries its PARENT (/usr/local) — the answer to the plan's "say which"; unchanged from what AS-75's resolveDockerBin already accepts, and that override would break the watcher's own deploy first. P4 PATH with a trailing ':' → '' enters the presence set, no candidate can equal it, and the child's PATH keeps the trailing ':' because the suffix is untouched. P8 whitespace-only extras dropped. P9 an extra already on PATH lands in `present`. P10 ADVANCE_GH_BIN=/nope/gh → unresolved ['gh:override-missing'], docker's dir still added. P12, on this host over the real process.env (fat PATH): {add: [], present: ['/usr/local/bin','/opt/homebrew/bin'], unresolved: []} — the exact shape AC-9 predicts for the live line.

MUTANTS — 9 planned run, 9 observed red, 0 survivors; plus my P1 above. Scratch copy from `git archive feat/AS-92-tick-path-prepend`, git-inited so deploy-shape can run, verified byte-identical to the worktree on the four touched files before and after each mutant; each mutation asserted applied at the intended site (pattern unique + the enclosing-function/marker check) and the hunk printed before the run. Observed vs predicted (§5):
- M1 delete docker dirname push: {T2, T3, T7, T8} vs predicted {T2, T4, T7, T8}. Same width, DIFFERENT MEMBERSHIP: T4 stays green by its own fixture (its EXTRA already names /usr/local/bin, so the resolver's push is redundant there); T3 goes red instead because its `present` list on the fat PATH expects both dirs. Prediction error, guard sound.
- M2 delete gh dirname push: {T2, T3, T4, T5, T7, T8} vs predicted {T2, T7, T8}. WIDER by T3 (present), T4 (add lacks the gh dir), T5 (the typo'd-docker case expects add ['/opt/homebrew/bin']). Every extra red is a correct consequence of the mutation; prediction narrow, guard sound.
- M3 no partition: {T3} = predicted; T7 stays green (thin PATH holds neither dir), as the plan says.
- M4 delete the EXTRA read: {T4} = predicted. M5 delete dedup: {T4} = predicted. Same set from two mutants, stated.
- M6 unconditional join: {T5} = predicted; T1 stays green because '/opt/bin:/usr/bin' joins to itself — the undefined witness is T5's alone.
- M7 override-missing falls through: {T6} = predicted.
- M8 spawn site drops the 4th arg: {T7} = predicted; the AS-82 pin at watcher-main.test.js:355 stayed GREEN under M8 by construction — confirmed, which is T7's reason to exist.
- M9 delete the TICK-PATH line: {T7} = predicted.
Summary counts under each mutant, from the runner: M1 537/533/4, M2 537/531/6, M3–M9 537/536/1 each, P1 537/537/0.

COUNTED RUNS (cardinality first).
